description: Cross-platform mobile application with Expo, React Native, and Expo Router

aiRules: You are building a cross-platform mobile application using Expo Router and React Native.
Use React Native primitives (<View>, <Text>, <TouchableOpacity>, <ScrollView>, etc.) and Expo Router in the app/ directory.
FULLSTACK CAPABILITY: A managed Express backend runs in server/index.js. In mobile screens, connect to API endpoints using process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:5001/api'.

DATABASE & PERSISTENCE: You can use SQLite (import { Database } from 'bun:sqlite'), PostgreSQL/MySQL with Prisma or Drizzle, MongoDB (mongoose), or cloud databases (Supabase, Firebase, Neon). Store secrets in .env.
Do not run dev servers in bash; the dev servers are managed automatically.
